title: European shares turn cautious ahead of Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote
summary: Asian and European equities traded cautiously on Friday morning with currency and bond markets holding their breath for Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote as Fed chair. S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures were off 0.1% while EURO STOXX 50 futures edged up 0.3% after Thursday's sharp sell-off, when a stronger-than-expected US durable goods print met an ECB account showing selected policymakers did not oppose a June hike.
